brand.name: Bandolero
brand.description: Created by Nelson Alfonso (founder of Selected Tobacco S.A.); distributed in the U.S. by United Cigars (David Garofalo's company). Blends are largely undisclosed/proprietary. Organized into three core series distinguished by wrapper shade, plus a newer premium line.
brand.origin_country: Costa Rica (rolled at Tabacos de Costa Rica, Puriscal; Premium line aged in Madrid, Spain)
brand.founded: Selected Tobacco founded 2012; Bandolero line introduced ~2014

line.name: Bandolero Serie C (Clandestinos)
line.wrapper: Ecuadorian Connecticut (lightest of the three series)

vitolas.name: Colosales
vitolas.notes: Mac filename spells it 'Colasales'; correct product name is 'Colosales'.

line.name: Bandolero Serie T (Traficantes)
line.wrapper: Natural/Colorado-shade (medium hue, between Serie A and C)
line.filler: Undisclosed; Peruvian ligero noted for Tremendos

line.name: Bandolero Premium
line.notes: Launched ~2025; rolled at Tabacos de Costa Rica, then aged 3 years in Madrid, Spain in cedar-lined humidors.

vitolas.name: Bravos
vitolas.notes: A 5.25x52 'Bravos' vitola also existed in the original ~2014 Bandolero lineup (5-cigar Premium Pack with humitubes) - filenames may reference either release; sizes match either way.

research_notes: Two filenames could not be decoded and are excluded: UC-Bandolero_Band-Osa-Fix_01.jpg and UC-Bandolero_Bando-Ash-Pack_01.jpg (no matching product found; the latter may be an accessory/ashtray shot).
